audit_gaps: GitHub code search returned no directory inventory for this private repository. Exhaustiveness is anchored to all declared members of the root, AiDENs, Primitives, and poly-kv workspaces plus every explicitly excluded root path.
demo-tauri-libraries/src-tauri is named in root exclude but does not exist at the audited ref; neither its Cargo.toml nor a parent package manifest was found.
No package README exists for 6 root crates, all 34 AiDENs crates, and 2 poly-kv crates; crate-level docs and manifests were used instead.
AiDENs/crates/aidens-boundary-kit has no src/lib.rs at the audited ref despite being a workspace member; its target layout requires manual confirmation.

Exact per-path last-modified timestamps are not exposed by the connector. Package-name commit search produced matches for 42 of 97 packages; remaining entries use the audited branch head as snapshot evidence and are labeled accordingly.

A missing publish=false flag means Cargo permits publishing; it does not establish that a crate is actually present on crates.io. Registry publication and download metrics must be verified separately.

Several manifests declare repository/homepage URLs outside RecursiveIntell/Libraries, including historical RecursiveIntell, NousResearch, and sikmindz URLs. These are reported verbatim as manifest metadata and were not treated as proof of current ownership.
Branch-local versions may differ from separately released repositories or crates.io. In particular, this audited branch declares semantic-memory 0.5.0.

registry_cross_check.methodology: Exact package-name intersection against the observed RecursiveIntell owner inventory. Registry names owned by other publishers are never counted as RecursiveIntell releases; normalized or similar names are not treated as matches.

known_collisions.note: The exact crates.io name agent-graph is registered by another publisher. It is not a RecursiveIntell-owned release and is not counted as publication evidence for this workspace package.
The crates.io names job-queue and job_queue are unrelated to this workspace package. RecursiveIntell's agent-queue is a distinct package and is not publication evidence for job-queue.
